verdict.rationale: Base44 is itself an AI app-building product where the core interaction is delegating tasks (build features, design, resolve conflicts) to a built-in AI assistant via chat, as documented in the AI-agents feature and corroborated by hands-on community reports of the AI resolving issues and building full apps from prompts. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of assistant task scope/limits and more first-party documentation detail on assistant capabilities beyond marketing copy.
